title: In, on or out of the loop
caption: Three levels of human oversight, set per task: the same workflow keeps a person in for one task, on for another and out for a third.

in.label: In the loop
in.name: Human in the loop
in.definition: The agent acts only after a person approves.

on.label: On the loop
on.name: Human on the loop
on.definition: It acts on its own while a person watches and can step in.

out.label: Out of the loop
out.name: Human out of the loop
out.definition: It acts without any person, who sees only the result.

example.label: One task, three ways
example.task: Book a venue for 200 on 20 June
example.listLabel: Booking the venue at each level

in.aside: Nothing is booked until you say yes.

on.aside: You read the reports and step in if something looks wrong.

goal.label: Goal
goal.text: 20 June: everyone celebrates together and gets home safely

risk.label: Risk
risk.hint: of a wrong result: highest where a person approves

origin.label: Borrowed terms
origin.words: The words: military policy on weapon autonomy, 2012
origin.concept: The concept: supervisory control in aircraft

origin-of-the-three-terms.description: the triad comes from a 2012 report on weapon autonomy: in the loop means force only with a human command, on the loop means under a human operator who can override, out of the loop means without any human input [1].

hrw-losing-humanity.title: Human Rights Watch and Harvard IHRC, Losing Humanity (19 Nov 2012)

two-senses-of-on.description: the EU 2019 ethics guidelines define on the loop as intervening during design and monitoring operation, which differs from the military override sense used here; the guidelines have no out-of-the-loop term [1].

eu-hleg-ethics-guidelines.title: EU High-Level Expert Group on AI, Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI (8 Apr 2019)

approving-to-monitoring.description: experienced users shift from approving individual actions to monitoring the agent and intervening when needed [1].

anthropic-measuring-agent-autonomy.title: Anthropic, Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice (18 Feb 2026)

out-is-a-per-step-property.description: no source claims a person is out of the loop for a whole lifecycle; the humans move to specs and outcome checks [1].

willison-software-factory.title: Willison, How StrongDM's AI team build serious software without even looking at the code

regulation-limits-out.description: for high-risk uses, EU AI Act Article 14 requires that a person can override and stop the system [1].

eu-ai-act-article-14.title: EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689), Article 14 Human oversight

aviation-supplied-the-concept-not-the-wo.header: Aviation supplied the concept, not the words
aviation-supplied-the-concept-not-the-wo.description: Sheridan traces supervisory control to computers replacing direct manual control in aircraft, which left the person "in a new role of monitor and goal-constraint setter"; no source traces the words "in, on, out of the loop" to aviation, they come from the military policy above [1].

sheridan-human-supervisory-control.title: Sheridan, Human Supervisory Control (Handbook of Systems Engineering and Management, Wiley, 1999, ch. 16)

levels-are-not-a-strict-ladder.header: Levels are not a strict ladder
levels-are-not-a-strict-ladder.description: the FAA warns that describing automation as a linear hierarchy of levels is difficult to apply operationally, and that responsibility for flightpath management stays with the pilots at all times; it concerns airline pilots, so carrying it to agents is an analogy [1].

faa-ac-120-123.title: FAA, Advisory Circular 120-123, Flightpath Management (21 Nov 2022)

in.title: In
in.script: Human in the loop means the agent acts only after a person has approved. Take booking the venue for the party: the agent proposes a venue, and nothing is booked until you say yes.

on.title: On
on.script: Human on the loop means the agent acts on its own while a person watches and can step in. Now the agent books the venue itself, you read its reports, and you step in when something looks wrong.

out.title: Out
out.script: Human out of the loop means the agent acts without any person, who sees only the result. The agent books the venue, and all you get is the confirmation.

borrowed-terms.title: Borrowed terms
borrowed-terms.script: These three terms were borrowed from automation outside AI, from fields where an automated action often cannot be undone, so what role the person plays was decided on purpose and not left to chance. The detail is in the Speaker notes. We borrow them because the question is the same for your agents.

per-task.title: Per task
per-task.script: So you choose per task, not per company. Minimal intervention stops being a vague promise and becomes a setting that you choose, task by task.
